Conditions

  • Ephemeral Whispers

    • Tempted by Ethel's whispers.
    • This creature must succeed a  DC 13 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of their turn or be inflicted with  Hag's Pawn.

Features

  • Darkvision

    Can see in the dark up to a certain distance.

  • Deflect Missiles

    Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level.

  • Evasion

    Successful DEX saves nullify damage; failed DEX saves reduce it by half.

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Fey Ancestry

    Advantage on saving throws against being charmed; can't be put to sleep by magic.

  • Ki-Empowered Strikes

    Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage.

  • Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike

    After making an attack with a melee Monk weapon or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action.

  • Martial Arts: Deft Strikes

    Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher.

  • Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks

    Attacks with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks scale with your Dexterity instead of your Strength if your Dexterity is higher.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

  • Part of the Flock

    Auntie Ethel welcomes you, dearie.

  • Slow Fall

    When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage.

  • Stillness of Mind

    If Charmed or Frightened, automatically cast Stillness of Mind to remove them.

  • Unarmoured Defence

    Your reflexes are as effective as any armour. While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your  Armour Class.

  • Unarmoured Movement

    Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield.

LOW_Masked_Monk
Mask of Terror is a human member of Auntie Ethel's flock. He can be found in the The Blushing Mermaid alongside  Mask of Vengeance,  Mask of Servitude, and the real  Captain Grisly.
“
Auntie? AUNTIE!
„
— Mask of Terror

Involvement

Act Three

Like the other Masks, the Mask of Terror wanders around the basement area. If the party did not discover Ethel was impersonating Grisly, or antagonised Ethel upstairs, then they all are hostile. However, if the party agreed to Ethel's deal as part of ⁠Gather Your Allies then they are not hostile and can even be spoken to. Mask of Terror recounts making a deal with Auntie to get back at people who laughed at him.

If the party confront Auntie Ethel in the basement's next-door room, then she and other the other members of the flock are teleported into the battle as long as they were not previously killed or knocked out. They are hostile by virtue of the  Whispering Mask, placing them under the  Charming effect of  Part of the Flock.

If the party encounters Mask of Terror after Ethel is dead, he is no longer hostile but his sanity is broken.
